HOW TO USE IT

Four moves, then you know your number.

Pick a live market, read the book, model the chance you actually believe, and keep the plan on this device. XO Lens never places a trade.

  1. 01

    Pick a market

    Search or filter the live XO list, or start a custom scenario of your own.

  2. 02

    Read the book

    The chart is XO history. The ladder is the live yes book. The price you type is a planned fill, not an order.

  3. 03

    Model your view

    Set a budget, any costs, and your probability. The desk shows the win, the loss, break-even, and your edge.

  4. 04

    Save the plan

    Check the rules and sources, write why you believe it, then save. It stays in this browser until you export it.

How the calculation works

The budget buys shares at your entry price. Each winning share pays $1; a losing share pays $0. Costs are added to your budget. Expected net result = your probability × shares − budget − costs. Break-even = (budget + costs) ÷ shares. These are scenarios, not forecasts or executable quotes. Void refunds depend on market rules.
